greptile.note: All findings from both rounds addressed in code on this branch. No waiver requested in either round, and none would be valid here: no instruction from Ove exists for this PR.

round_2_findings.title: Contract pre-flight cannot pass
round_2_findings.verdict: VALID — reproduced: ci/gates/check_contracts.py:180 returns 1 with 'contract surfaces changed but no change document supplied' when a surface is touched and --change is absent, whether or not a change document exists on disk
round_2_findings.disposition: FIXED — the pre-flight G-4 line is annotated, the bare form is scoped to diffs touching no contract surface, and the --change form is shown with the change document's required fields and a pointer to docs/cross-bot-protocol.md and skills/contract-first-changes.

round_2_findings.title: QUALITY cannot approve itself
round_2_findings.verdict: VALID — G-2 rejects approved_by equal to the authoring bot, so bot-06 cannot stamp a change to its own files, which is exactly what this PR is
round_2_findings.disposition: FIXED — the sequence now names the approver per author (QUALITY for a build seat; LEAD or a human for QUALITY's own work, never bot-06 itself), and a paragraph gives the human:<name> and bot-00-programming-lead forms, both already in use under .receipts/bot-06-quality-security/, citing skills/verification-receipts. It also states that approved_by stays absent rather than self-filled until the independent stamp lands.

round_1_findings.title: Full pre-flight cannot pass yet
round_1_findings.verdict: VALID — confirmed against ci/gates/check_receipt.py:101, where approved_by is required unconditionally rather than only under --strict
round_1_findings.disposition: FIXED — the order-of-operations block no longer tells a seat to pass run_all.py before committing. It now names the per-gate pre-flight commands, states that G-2 is expected to fail on 'approved_by' is missing alone, and puts the first fully green run_all.py under QUALITY after the stamp.

round_1_findings.title: Scanner guarantee is overstated
round_1_findings.verdict: VALID — G-2 matches recorded command strings against the fixed BYPASS_PATTERNS list; it does not verify that a scanner was enabled or that a suite ran
round_1_findings.disposition: FIXED — the waiver section now scopes the assurance to the listed bypass forms when the command is in the receipt, and states that a command left out of the receipt is invisible to G-2, so a green G-2 is evidence about recorded commands rather than proof the right commands ran.

round_1_findings.title: Waiver policies remain inconsistent
round_1_findings.verdict: VALID — docs/github-sot-orchestration.md §4.2 describes the waiver without the explicit-Ove-instruction condition
round_1_findings.disposition: FIXED WITHIN OWNERSHIP — §4.2 is owned by bot-00-programming-lead and G-1 blocks bot-06 from editing it, so the divergence is now declared in docs/quality-gates.md: the new section is named the operative rule until LEAD reconciles §4.2, and a waiver authored against §4.2 alone does not clear a merge claim. Reconciling §4.2 remains LEAD's change.
